title: Municipal Pension Plan: Excellence in Public Sector Pension Management Canada 2025
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html: Municipal Pension Plan is recognised distinctively for exemplary stewardship of one of Canada’s largest defined benefit pension arrangements, demonstrating how purpose-led governance and disciplined innovation can safeguard member security while preparing for long-term systemic change. Serving approximately 470,000 members, the Plan anchors every strategic decision to its legislated mandate of paying pensions reliably, a focus reinforced by its fully funded status, consistent cost-of-living adjustments and continued access to post-retirement health and dental benefits. A defining differentiator is the Plan’s growth for generations strategy, which expands access to secure retirement income for British Columbians, strengthening communities and the broader economy while improving long-term risk pooling. The Judging Panel also recognises the Plan’s leadership in risk-aware responsible investment, notably its net zero goal, adopted as part of the Plan’s risk adjusted return investment policy and already achieving a 50percent reduction in portfolio emissions against a 55percent 2030 interim target as measured by the British Columbia Investment Management Corporation (BCI), alongside $4.4bn allocated to climate-related opportunities. Governance excellence is sustained through a long-standing joint trustee model, ensuring balanced oversight while enabling  strategic policy responses to emerging risks, from cybersecurity to geopolitical instability. Operational efficiency is further enhanced through close collaboration with its investment manager BCI, lowering costs through internal investment asset management , improving net returns for members. This approach underpins confidence, transparency and resilience across cycles, reinforcing trust among members, employers and stakeholders alike nationwide and over time. The Capital Finance International (CFI.co) Judging Panel congratulates Municipal Pension Plan on winning the 2025 Excellence in Public Sector Pension Management Award (Canada).
